scope: exploratory development analyses; historical fits never replaced
development_ids: exact original train_ids only; 51 designs in 42 frozen duplicate groups
historical_evaluation: 13 previously inspected designs; reconstruction/descriptive residuals only; no new untouched test claim
hyperparameter_selection: none; no regularization, new model class or selection using the historical evaluation set
residual_sign: prediction minus saved sampled UMA target, eV
bootstrap: draw 42 whole development groups with replacement; preserve multiplicities; reject and retain rank-deficient fit records separately for each model
ranking: lower score preferred; only the 51 development patterns; fixed full-development OLS reference for each model; average ranks and stable ID tie-breaking for top10/argmin
sampling_sensitivity: nested first-two versus all-four saved starts; common four-start bare reference; gas components and paired difference separately; development labels only for exploratory fits
uncertainty_limits: resampling summaries conditional on fixed targets, not physical confidence intervals; nested-start sensitivity and within-start ranges are not calibrated sampling errors
failure_policy: record all rank-deficient fits and incomplete CV coverage; no retries, pseudoinverse substitution or silent removal; stop on source hash/split/target inconsistency
execution: local small-array CPU analysis only; no QE, UMA inference or downloads
